review.identity: deepseek-1 (agent, deepseek-v4.1-flash; reviewer session, same agent identity as the implementer, fresh context; rebased by hand after the lander conflict onto 63b5b32e8 and then onto c8a641983, re-verified every load-bearing image pin by independent disassembly)
review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_GAME_DIR and CS_ENGINE_IMAGE set); this report is derived from the recorded log plus a second production pass recorded in behavior.json. MEASURED (identifiers, numbers and digests only, no original display text, no script text, no disassembly committed): static analysis of the owner-supplied decrypted engine image (sha-256 43540fc97347210d..., image base 0x400000, 24 byte windows re-read by accept_t452_r02_the_image_pins_every_measured_site) for what each effect flag does: BEEPER places a timed marker on the struck actor whose duration is the record TIME (default 5.0 s, wep_10 20 s); SONIC and FLASH run the exposure routine 0x42e840, whose intensity is clamp(1 - 2.5 * (ratio - 0.6), 0, 1) with ratio the per-hit measure over the attacker field +0x3c squared, FLASH additionally scaled by the facing dot product, and whose incapacitation duration is intensity * 5.0 s; TANGLER builds an area field (0x4b94e0) of radius RADIUS (default 10.0 m, squared at +0x14) lasting TIME (default 5.0 s, wep_12 2 s) that re-applies the weapon per-hit routine to every actor inside the radius each tick; SMOKE_SCREEN creates a scene emitter node (0x4b8d50) lasting TIME (default 5.0 s, wep_13 8 s) with no gameplay radius and, for a record that states no TIME, the image's own 5.0 s default with an ImageDefault provenance label; BEEPER_SEEKER installs the per-step retarget callback 0x441780. The end of flight is gated at 0x5b01f9..0x5b0211 on LOCK_ON (0x8000, set by the LOCK_ON key) without EXPIRES (0x80), or on DETONATE_AT_RANGE (0x2000000); a record with neither is marked dead at 0x5b0318 without detonating, which is wep_12, wep_13 and wep_26 -- wep_12's DETONATION_DISTANCE cannot reach the LOCK_ON-gated proximity branch. The steering (0x5af7f4) and proximity (0x5b0216) guards test LOCK_ON, not ROCKET, so wep_25 inherits the twelve-record lost-target rule. CLUSTER_SIZE (+0x0c) is a per-launch countdown: one launch pass calls the one-projectile builder 0x5aef40 exactly once (0x4b7289), the count is decremented at 0x4b72be and the loop stops at 0, so one projectile per sub-munition. Per component the same production reader (cs_content::ordnance::read_original_component_table) is measured by measure_component_behavior: wep_12 gets radius 10 m, lifetime 2 s and the silent end of flight; wep_13 lifetime 8 s and no measured radius; wep_08/wep_09 the exposure formula with no forced runtime kind; wep_10 the marker kind; wep_11 the beeper-seeker claim; wep_12, wep_13 and wep_26 expire silently; wep_25 detonates and resolves the lost-target claim; every volley launches one projectile per sub-munition. NOT CLAIMED: any original-run behavior (retail is read access and no agent ran the original executable); what a zero-damage tangler does to a flight model (t452_r02.limit.tangler_flight_effect), a gameplay radius for smoke (t452_r02.limit.smoke_radius), a StatusEffectKind for pilot incapacitation (t452_r02.limit.status_incapacitation) and a GuidanceRule for repeated beeper retargeting (t452_r02.limit.beeper_seeker_guidance). The claim is implemented: a code and test pass awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
